actions.title: Review member adoption of MolI's general resource-aware execution rule (#96)
actions.body:
## Platform decision and delegated receiving

MolI [#96](https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/issues/96) publishes the general [resource-aware contributor rule](https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/blob/dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b/devguide/policies/resource_aware_execution.md), with root/shared/starter actions at [dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b](https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/commit/dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b). Original #95 is superseded by #96 and [UIBCDF infrastructure #1](https://github.com/uibcdf/uibcdf-infrastructure/issues/1), not a resolved protection incident.

MolSysSuite owns its member rule, instructions, workload profiles and receiving. Please review/adopt the general action through that existing governance route: trusted active-policy loading before expensive execution; whole-job estimates and bounded concurrency; actual scheduler/admission and child-family limits; observations versus reservations; pressure monitoring; bounded deferral/cancellation of owned work; honest incomplete outcomes/cleanup. Keep thresholds, machine configuration, systemd/cgroups/Slurm mechanisms and operational recovery with infrastructure owners.

The [portable integration proposal](https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/blob/dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b/devguide/pending_proposals/execution_infrastructure_contract.md) is design review material only. No serialized API, executable policy-discovery/admission adapter, universal scheduler or UIBCDF runtime dependency is implemented or mandatory. Coordinate any suite needs with MolI #96 and the independent provider; do not introduce competing Run/ExecutionPlan or scientific meaning.

## Owner outcome

Record the independently accepted member working rule, canonical/starter/root reading route, owner-specific workload/estimate guidance and actual receiving/deferrals. Distinguish instruction delivery from enforceable whole-process limits and concurrent admission proof. Preserve active prefixes/sessions, useful evidence and unrelated work. A sandboxed/reference integration needs separate owner authorization; no host stress test, provisioning, model job, member source change or rollout is executed centrally by this issue.

MolI's exact-source governance passes 55 tests and coverage. Five direct guide copies remain pending; this proves no member adoption or infrastructure protection. Existing suite publication/inventory/environment/Discussions work retains its own scope.

MolI #96 supplies a portable integration proposal for provider review, source [dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b](https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/commit/dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b): [general resource-aware rule](https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/blob/dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b/devguide/policies/resource_aware_execution.md), [request/discovery/admission/status/cancellation design](https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/blob/dd4ac1301b092038934b594afbf7ec559ab20a1b/devguide/pending_proposals/execution_infrastructure_contract.md).

MolI defines workload constraints and general contributor conduct. Your independent provider owns site policy, coordination, reservations, enforceable child-family limits, scheduler integration and operational recovery. No host-specific configuration, deployment, credentials or real workload is requested here; no UIBCDF dependency is added to scientific code.

Please review the minimum semantic groups and unsupported-capability behavior before selecting a versioned executable contract. Policy text must be explicitly discovered/loaded rather than merely linked; a resource observation must not impersonate admission; bounded deferral and cancellation/confirmed termination need distinct states. The two-offline-provider/reference integration exercises are planned, not executed proof. This is no frozen wire schema or instruction to implement unreviewed keys. #95's superseded closure means coordination was acknowledged, not that resource safety is resolved. Keep implementation and site details with the provider; return relevant public/sanitized contract corrections to MolI #96.
